thesis.text: Senior plc is confirmed to be in an active Takeover Code offer period based on recurring Rule 8.3 concert-party dealing disclosures; this specific filing is routine (dividend reinvestment by a PDMR) and adds no new information on offer terms or price, but the presence of ongoing Form 8 filings and shifting major-holder positions (e.g., Societe Generale) signals live market activity around a potential deal that warrants continued monitoring of subsequent RNS releases for offer terms, competing bids, or board recommendations.
